evals.prompt: I'm building a Next.js app with shadcn/ui (base-nova preset, lucide icons). Create a settings form component with fields for: full name, email address, and notification preferences (email, SMS, push notifications as toggle options). Add validation states for required fields.
evals.expected_output: An accessible settings form with appropriate independent notification controls, useful validation, and a layout that fits the labels and viewport.
expectations: Inputs have associated labels; grouping is appropriate to the form rather than tied to a particular wrapper component
Notification preferences support independent on/off choices with appropriate keyboard and accessible state behavior
Validation reflects the actual invalid control and provides an actionable explanation
Layout accommodates narrow screens and long labels without overlap
Status and text are legible across relevant themes; state is not conveyed solely by color
Component and styling choices fit the task; equivalent accessible structures and CSS utilities are acceptable

evals.prompt: Create a dialog component for editing a user profile. It should have the user's avatar at the top, input fields for name and bio, and Save/Cancel buttons with appropriate icons. Using shadcn/ui with radix-nova preset and tabler icons.
evals.expected_output: An accessible profile-editing dialog using the specified primitive and icon library, with clear save/cancel behavior and useful identity presentation.
expectations: The dialog has an accessible name, normally supplied through the installed DialogTitle API
The identity presentation remains understandable when the avatar image is unavailable
Buttons have accessible names and icons remain legible and aligned
Icon sizes fit the control and interaction target; explicit sizes are acceptable when useful
The specified tabler icon library is respected, through shared exports when the host project requires them
Custom triggers follow the installed primitive API, preserving semantics and focus behavior

evals.prompt: Create a dashboard component that shows 4 stat cards in a grid. Each card has a title, large number, percentage change badge, and a loading skeleton state. Using shadcn/ui with base-nova preset and lucide icons.
evals.expected_output: A responsive dashboard with the requested stat information, meaningful loading states, and readable changes. Card parts and styling serve the content.
expectations: Each stat presents its title, value, and percentage change with understandable hierarchy
Loading feedback distinguishes pending data from a real value without misleading users
Percentage changes include readable values and direction or meaning beyond color
The palette remains legible in relevant themes, including any justified domain-specific colors
The grid and spacing adapt to the viewport and actual content
Card sections are chosen for the requested information; unused sections or actions are unnecessary
